action.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN due_date >= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current' WHEN date_diff('day', due_date, DATE '2026-06-30') BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN date_diff('day', due_date, DATE '2026-06-30') BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket, SUM(amount - amount_paid) AS outstanding FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' AND amount - amount_paid > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'current' THEN 1 WHEN '1-30' THEN 2 WHEN '31-60' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
